description:
Use this when the user wants a clip called something else: "rename this clip", "call it Clutch ace", "change
        the title". Changes the clip's name in the Library (a saved photo too); the video and its captions are not
        touched. clip_id: from list_clips. title: the new name, 1 to 140 characters. The answer gives the old
        title, so a rename can be reversed by renaming back.
        Not for: the words inside the clip (edit_clip, write_captions) or a post's caption (write_captions,
        update_draft). Free: no Horizon Units.
name: rename_clip
title: Rename a clip
